source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of algorithm analysis (PDF 78).

blocks.text: Algorithm analysis woh process hai jis mein algorithms ki computational complexity maloom ki jati hai, yani un ki time complexity (waqt) aur space complexity (memory). Yeh analysis algorithm ki performance ka pehle se andaza lagane mein madad deta hai aur kisi khaas kaam ke liye behtareen algorithm chunne ke liye bohat zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt: Algorithm analysis kaunse do resources naapta hai?

items: Algorithm analysis: time aur space complexity, algorithms ko compare karne aur behtareen chunne ke liye.
